description: Creates a new department (department_master) under an organization/branch.

body.departmentCode: string(30), required at API layer (nullable at DB layer)

validation: departmentName must not be null (NOT NULL)
departmentName must be unique within organization + branch (UNIQUE uq_department_org_name)
departmentCode, if provided, must be unique within organization + branch (UNIQUE uq_department_org_code)

errors.condition: departmentCode or departmentName missing (API-layer required field)
organizationId or branchId does not exist
departmentCode or departmentName already exists within organization + branch

notes: department_code has no NOT NULL constraint at the database level (only department_name is NOT NULL), but docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx documents departmentCode as a required request field. This contract follows the documented API-level requirement (stricter than the DB) as intentional API validation, not a database gap - the DB still permits NULL department_code for other callers/migrations. No dedicated api_contracts_test SQL file existed yet for Department Management; API-T187-API-T190 are net-new IDs continuing the global sequence (previous max was API-T186) and still need a backing api_contracts_test script.
